probe: 4B fp16 load on RTX 4060 Laptop (8 GiB)
interpretation: The model loads only because Windows WDDM backs the over-budget allocation with shared host memory; no device memory is left for any KV cache. A forward pass therefore cannot run at 32k, and a per-item curve on the fp16 base is not measurable on this device.
consequence: 4B@32k per-item weights curve cannot be produced in the paper's protocol (fp16 base). Measured alternative: per-item on an nf4 base at 8k, or keep the 0.6B grid and state the binding-regime gap.
